principle: Static ambiguity is tracked without being treated as proof of exposure. Live Supabase policy and route authorization evidence remain authoritative.

verification.method: Live pg_policies, pg_class RLS flags, role grants, function ACLs and Supabase security advisors were inspected against the production project.
verification.legacyTables: Surviving legacy tables were hardened to remove anonymous access and deprecated auth.role()-based policies where applicable.
verification.retiredTables: Historical report-delivery, scrape, valuation-quote and PP-learning tables referenced by the listed migrations are not present in the current public schema.
verification.modernModules: Market and valuation tables have RLS enabled; valuation case/version/comparable policies are scoped by authenticated user and management scope; market shared-reference tables are read-only through RLS for authenticated users.
verification.neighborhoodReview: The historical neighborhood-review migration was rechecked against live production policy state on 2026-09-01. market_neighborhood_review_items has RLS enabled; SELECT is restricted to admin/ceo, UPDATE is restricted to admin/ceo plus AAL2, and service_role retains the explicit operational policy. The historical AAL2-only policy text is therefore not the effective authorization surface.

requiredResolution.apiRoutes: Keep explicit authentication/capability guards on privileged routes and service-role operations.
requiredResolution.historicalMigrations: Re-run live verification after material schema/RLS changes; historical SQL text alone is not proof of current exposure.
